source_refs.note: Chapter 6 exercise as printed (PDF 171-174, printed 168-171): 18 MCQs, 9 short and 8 long questions, without answers. The answer key (PDF 226) is used in the Roman Urdu lesson only.

blocks.text: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
1. What is the main benefit of edge computing?
2. Which cloud deployment model is characterized by resources being shared among multiple organizations with common concerns?
3. In what way does a private cloud differ from a public cloud?

items: a) A private cloud is owned and used by multiple organizations
b) A private cloud offers less control over data and resources
c) A private cloud is dedicated to a single organization and offers more control over data and security
d) A private cloud is cheaper and less secure than a public cloud

blocks.text: 4. What is a key advantage of using a distributed ledger in blockchain technology?

items: a) Centralized control for quick decision-making
b) The ability to easily alter transaction histories
c) Enhanced transparency and security due to decentralized verification
d) Reduced computational power needed for maintaining the ledger

blocks.text: 5. Which of the following is NOT a type of cloud service?
6. Which cloud deployment model combines public and private cloud features?
7. In the context of blockchain, what is the purpose of using a distributed ledger?

items: a) To allow only one central authority to manage the blockchain
b) To enable multiple participants to share and verify data in a secure and transparent manner
c) To reduce the number of participants needed to maintain the network
d) To keep the data hidden from all participants except the central authority

blocks.text: 8. Which type of cloud service provides a platform allowing customers to develop, run, and manage applications without dealing with the underlying infrastructure?
9. Which service model allows developers to build and deploy applications without managing servers?
10. What does Blockchain 2.0 introduce beyond basic cryptocurrency applications?

items: b) Decentralized applications and smart contracts

blocks.text: 11. What is a primary advantage of serverless architectures?

items: b) Need for constant server management

blocks.text: 12. How does integrating AI with blockchain benefit data management?

items: b) Enhances data security and transparency

blocks.text: 13. Which of the following best describes immutability in blockchain?

items: a) The ability to modify records with administrator privileges
b) The feature that allows data to be changed only under specific conditions
c) The characteristic of data being unalterable once added to the blockchain
d) The capability to remove data from the blockchain when no longer needed

blocks.text: 14. Which of the following is an example of edge computing in use?
15. What is one of the environmental concerns related to blockchain technology?
16. What is the primary function of a Peer-to-Peer (P2P) network in blockchain technology?

items: a) To increase the speed of transactions
b) To allow central authorities to control the network
c) To enable direct data sharing between nodes without a central server
d) To reduce the need for encryption in the network

blocks.text: 17. Which technology benefits from processing data at the "edge" of the network?
18. What is a smart contract in the context of Blockchain 2.0?

items: b) A self-executing contract with terms directly written into code
c) A contract managed by a third party

blocks.text: Short Questions

items: Analyze the role of Peer-to-Peer Networks in Blockchain. How do they function and why are they essential?
Describe the concept of immutability in blockchain. Why is it a critical feature?
What is edge computing and how does it benefit data processing?
Describe the concept of serverless architectures.
What are smart contracts in Blockchain 2.0?
How does integrating blockchain with IoT improve supply chain management?
What advantages do serverless architectures offer to developers?
How does edge computing improve the efficiency of autonomous vehicles?
Differentiate between Elasticity and On-Demand access in cloud computing.

blocks.text: Long Questions

items: Explain the structure of a distributed ledger and evaluate the rationale behind its decentralization.
Define cloud deployment models and assess the differences among them.
Classify the various types of cloud services and compare them, highlighting key distinctions.
Discuss the advancements and benefits of edge computing in modern technology.
Explain the concept of serverless architectures and their impact on application development.
Describe Blockchain 2.0 and its advanced features.
How does integrating blockchain with AI and IoT create new opportunities and synergies?
